summary: Unwired-task quarantine built (DORMANT until daemon restart). daemon.js: buildGraph stamps unwired:true on tasks FIRST SEEN with zero edges (pre-feature tasks exempt — they already carry firstSeen); /overlay/status 409s an in_progress claim of an unwired task; new POST /mark-root {task_key, reason?} clears the flag + records reason in the note. lib/overlay.js: unwired is a persisted local field; addEdge clears the flag on either endpoint (covers add_dependency AND lexical autowire). lib/mcp-core.js: new mark_root tool. hooks/suggest-links.sh (both copies, ~/.claude/orchestrator + repo): PostToolUse(TaskCreate) now ALWAYS emits the quarantine reminder, with link candidates appended when available. subject: Wiring enforcement: daemon quarantine for unwired tasks + TaskCreate hook
